Company description: TXN (Generated via gemini-3.1-flash-lite)

Texas Instruments Incorporated (TXN) is a global semiconductor design and manufacturing company headquartered in Dallas, Texas. Founded in 1930 as Geophysical Service Inc., the company transitioned into electronics and famously developed the first commercial silicon transistor in 1954 and the integrated circuit in 1958. Today, Texas Instruments focuses primarily on analog chips and embedded processors, which serve as the essential building blocks for electronic equipment across the industrial, automotive, personal electronics, communications equipment, and enterprise systems markets. By leveraging a vast portfolio of tens of thousands of products, the company enables signal processing and power management in a wide array of applications. Texas Instruments distinguishes itself through its extensive internal manufacturing capabilities, including significant wafer fabrication facilities, which allow the company to maintain control over its supply chain and production efficiency. Through its commitment to innovation and long-term capital allocation, the firm remains a cornerstone of the global semiconductor industry.
